title: Sell Mineral Rights in Ellsworth, PA
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Ellsworth, PA | Washington County
metaDescription: Ellsworth sits near Ten Mile Creek in Washington County's Marcellus wet-gas core. We buy PA mineral and royalty interests directly from owners, cash, no broker.
heroLead: Ellsworth sits along Ten Mile Creek in southern Washington County, a small borough surrounded by farmland that's been steadily leased for Marcellus development for years.
intro: Southern Washington County, including the ground around Ellsworth, has drawn consistent operator interest for its wet-gas Marcellus production, and a lot of families here signed leases during the early 2000s leasing wave that have since gone through multiple rounds of drilling and, in some cases, royalty renegotiation. If your family's interest is tied to one of these long-running leases, we look at both the original terms and current activity before discussing what a sale might be worth.
We buy Ellsworth-area mineral and royalty interests directly, in cash, without asking you to navigate a broker or a listing process.

sections.heading: Ten Mile Creek Farmland in the Wet-Gas Belt
paragraphs: The farmland along Ten Mile Creek near Ellsworth sits well within Washington County's core wet-gas fairway, an area that's attracted sustained interest from Range Resources and other operators. This is established ground, not speculative acreage, which generally means clearer nearby production data to look at when we're evaluating a specific interest.
Whether your particular tract has been part of an actively producing unit still depends on the specific section, so we check that before discussing value.

sections.heading: Old Coal Patch Roots, Modern Gas Leases
paragraphs: Like a lot of southern Washington County, Ellsworth has a coal-mining history that predates any gas leasing by decades. Some older deeds in the area reserved coal separately from oil and gas, which we check carefully when tracing a family's chain of title, since it directly affects what a modern Marcellus lease actually covers.

sections.heading: What a Direct Cash Offer Actually Means
paragraphs: We buy Ellsworth-area interests directly from owners, which means there's no broker taking a percentage and no waiting for a buyer to show up on some listing platform. For families with an established, actively producing interest, that directness can mean getting a fair number in hand faster than trying to sell through a traditional process.

faqs.question: Is Ellsworth in an active Marcellus wet-gas area?
faqs.answer: Yes, southern Washington County including this area has seen sustained wet-gas development for years, though we check activity at the specific parcel level.

faqs.question: My family's deed mentions coal being sold off long ago. Do we still own gas rights?
faqs.answer: Possibly, depending on how the original coal severance was worded. We trace the full chain of title to determine what remains with your family.

faqs.question: How is selling directly to you different from listing my interest?
faqs.answer: There's no broker commission and no waiting for a buyer through a listing process. We evaluate and make an offer directly.
